steps.en: Stage order is read from stored settings, not fixed in the program
steps.id: Urutan stage dibaca dari pengaturan yang tersimpan, bukan tetap di program
steps.why_en: Only the letter job reads a stored order; manual changes ignore it and some moves are fixed in the program.
steps.why_id: Hanya job surat yang membaca urutan tersimpan; perubahan manual mengabaikannya dan sebagian perpindahan tetap di program.

steps.en: Officer edits the next stage from the staff portal
steps.id: Officer mengubah stage berikutnya dari portal staff
steps.why_en: Only a generic settings page exists, and nothing that moves a stage reads what it saves.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada halaman pengaturan umum, dan tidak ada proses pemindah stage yang membaca isinya.

steps.en: Each notice type can have its own stage setup
steps.id: Tiap jenis notice bisa punya susunan stage sendiri
steps.why_en: Settings have no notice type field; per-type behaviour is fixed in the program.
steps.why_id: Pengaturan tidak punya kolom jenis notice; perilaku per jenis tetap di program.

steps.en: The daily job moves notices through the stages in the set order
steps.id: Job harian memajukan notice antar stage sesuai urutan yang diatur
steps.why_en: The daily letter job is switched off in the program; letters run only when someone starts them.
steps.why_id: Job surat harian dimatikan di program; surat hanya jalan kalau ada yang menjalankannya manual.

steps.en: A manual stage change follows the configured order
steps.id: Perubahan stage manual mengikuti urutan yang diatur
steps.why_en: A manual change simply uses the stage the officer picks, with today's date.
steps.why_id: Perubahan manual hanya memakai stage yang dipilih officer, dengan tanggal hari ini.
